import os
base='/workspace/source/src/main/java/com/puppycrawl/tools/checkstyle/'
for name in ('XmlLoader.java','PropertyCacheFile.java'):
 p=base+name
 data=open(p,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read().splitlines()
 print('FILE',name,'LINES',len(data))
 for i,l in enumerate(data,1):
  print(f'{i:4d}|{l}')
 print('---END',name)
